# React TypeScript: type-safe patterns for React 18-19 (hooks, Server Components, routing)

Curated by Skill Harbor — @softaworks' deep reference skill for type-safe React with TypeScript, covering React 18–19: typed component and event-handler patterns (specific event types, discriminated unions for variant props, ComponentPropsWithoutRef), hook typing (explicit useState unions, useRef null-vs-mutable, custom-hook tuple returns with `as const`, useContext null guards), generic components with type inference, and the React 19 changes (ref as a regular prop instead of forwardRef, useActionState replacing useFormState, the `use()` promise-unwrapping API) — plus async Server Components, Server Actions, and type-safe routing with TanStack Router (Zod-validated search params) and React Router v7 (framework-mode type generation). Every section states ALWAYS/NEVER rules and points to dedicated reference files. Honest caveats: React-only — nothing for Vue, Svelte or vanilla TS; the bundled reference files are part of the skill, so the agent should fetch the whole skill directory, not just SKILL.md. MIT-licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
